requested_outcome: Verify the vacation sitemap against current Google guidance and expose a complete per-family and per-file sitemap inventory in the authenticated VII administration system.
natural_destination: The live VII sitemap files and the authenticated /admin/growth management surface.
authorization_boundary: Read-only research, local implementation and verification are authorized. A live production publication remains a separate release action requiring current authorization and exact release verification.

lesson_bundle.reason: The requested result belongs in the daily management surface.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The admin must expose actionable, role-protected, reload-safe sitemap details rather than a decorative total.

lesson_bundle.reason: Sitemaps and crawl eligibility are launch gates.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The implementation must be checked against current official Google guidance and the real XML output.

lesson_bundle.reason: A code-only result would not prove the natural admin destination.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Open the exact admin view, exercise loading, success and permission states, and inspect desktop and mobile.

lesson_bundle.reason: Every sitemap family and file must use the same diagnostic model.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inventory all families, not only vacations, and verify consistent fields and controls.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only a total count is shown and Adir still cannot tell what each XML file contains.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Return section, file, URL count, byte size, language, image, content-type and sample details from the same sitemap source.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every XML file in the index has a matching admin row and expandable contents summary.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The vacations file is called too long without measuring it against Google limits.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Measure the live file and show both VII chunk capacity and Google protocol capacity.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Admin reports exact URL count and uncompressed bytes with a clear healthy/warning state.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The admin screen looks good locally but is inaccessible, broken on mobile or uses an unapproved Hebrew font.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use the protected API and existing Heebo admin surface, then inspect desktop, 390px mobile, loading, error and forbidden states.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Authenticated natural-destination checks and typography audit pass.

affected_family: authenticated admin desktop and mobile states

midpoint_gate.trigger: The protected sitemap API returns the first complete per-file report.
checks: Compare API totals to rendered XML totals
Verify vacations file exact count and byte size

attack_questions: Does every child sitemap in the index appear in admin?
Can a signed-out user retrieve the inventory?
Do desktop and 390px mobile show readable details without overflow?
Are URL, byte and language counts computed from the rendered XML rather than guessed?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Authenticated /admin/growth screenshot and interaction on the exact release candidate.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated sitemap-family reconciliation plus API, permission, build and typography checks.

effectiveness.baseline: The current admin API exposes only aggregate family URL and file counts; the live vacations file contains 2,420 URLs and 3,922,972 uncompressed bytes.
effectiveness.target: Every current sitemap file becomes understandable and directly openable from one admin surface without changing valid public sitemap URLs.
